## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Pārāyanatthutigāthā* ("Homage to the Way to the Beyond") is a canonical verse text situated within the *Cūḷaniddesa* (Cnd 3) of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Within SuttaCentral, two modern translations across two languages are recorded [SuttaCentral].
In terms of parallels and text reuse, the work directly corresponds to the concluding verses of praise in the *Pārāyanavagga* found at Snp 5.18 (PTS Snp 218) [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus detects Pali-internal text reuse consisting of 36 matching passages across three texts [DharmaNexus]. The core verse sequence (§0.3–8.4) shares a direct textual match of 992 characters with Snp 5.18 (§0.2–8.4) [DharmaNexus]. The verses are further subjected to word-by-word commentary within the *Cūḷaniddesa* itself in the *Pārāyanatthutigāthāniddesa* (Cnd 21), which accounts for 31 matches and 2,796 shared characters (longest match §1.1–5.1 aligning with §9.1–13.1) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records minor reuse (4 passages) with the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (Dutiyo bhāgo) [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches meeting the reporting threshold in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora are identified [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
